projects.title: SIGENTING — Kemendukbangga/BKKBN
projects.description: A national data information and monitoring platform (Sistem Informasi Gerakan Orang Tua Asuh Cegah Stunting) for the Ministry of Population and Family Development (Kemendukbangga/BKKBN). Supports 5-tier regional hierarchy monitoring across central, provincial, regency, district, and village levels alongside aid achievement statistics.

projects.title: TravelloMatic
projects.description: A tour and travel marketplace web platform built with Next.js that connects travelers with verified local tour operators. Features catalog discovery across tours, events, and attractions, multi-language and multi-currency support, and secure booking workflows.

projects.title: Kasir App
projects.description: A simple Point of Sale (POS) application built with NextJS, Tailwind CSS, and MySQL. This project showcases my skills in full stack development and database management.
